# captured from: generacy --version 0.0.1
Usage: generacy cockpit status [options] <epic-ref>

Print a one-shot snapshot of every ref in the epic body's phases.

Arguments:
  epic-ref    Epic ref. Accepts <n>, <owner>/<repo>#<n>, or
              https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n>.

Options:
  --json      Emit a single-line JSON envelope and exit. Disables color.
              (default: false)
  -h, --help  display help for command
